source_title: Labor Law Attorneys, at Blumenthal Nordrehaug Bhowmik De Blouw LLP, File Suit Against CMRE Financial Services, Inc., for Alleged Failure to Pay Employees' Full Wages
source_excerpt:
CMRE Financial Services, Inc. allegedly failed to provide employees with required meal and rest breaks. This resulted in an alleged loss of wages for the employees affected.
MENDOCINO, Calif. , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The San Francisco employment law attorneys, at Blumenthal Nordrehaug Bhowmik De Blouw LLP , filed a class action complaint alleging that CMRE Financial Services, Inc., violated the California Labor Code. The CMRE Financial Services, Inc. class action lawsuit, Case No. 26CV04535, is currently pending in the Mendocino County Superior Court of the State of California. A copy of the Complaint can be read here .
According to the lawsuit filed, CMRE Financial Services, Inc. allegedly (a) failed to pay minimum wages, (b) failed to pay overtime wages, (c) failed to provide legally required meal and rest periods, (d) failed to provide accurate itemized wage statements, (e) failed to reimburse for required expenses, (f) failed to pay sick wages, and (g) failed to provide wages when due, all in violation of the applicable Labor Code sections listed in California Labor Code Sections 201-203, 226, 226.7, 233, 246, 510, 512, 1194, 1197, 1197.1, 2802, and the applicable Wage Order(s), and thereby gives rise to civil penalties as a result of such alleged conduct.
The Complaint further alleges CMRE Financial Services, Inc. failed to provide employees with legally required meals and rest breaks. Specifically, employees were allegedly required from time to time to work in excess of four (4) hours without being provided ten (10) minute rest periods . The applicable California Wage Order requires employers to provide employees with off-duty rest periods, which the California Supreme Court defined as time during which an employee is relieved from all work related duties and free from employer control.
For more information about the class action lawsuit against CMRE Financial Services, Inc., call (800) 568-8020 to speak to an experienced California employment attorney today.
